payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped ClusterMediaPlacement: bus-coordinated home-node registry over FrickClusterBus. claim/resolve/release protocol, lowest-nodeId tie-break (no split-brain), TTL self-heal on missed release. Additive variants on ClusterEnvelope; LocalMediaPlacement stays single-box default. 9 new tests, 1053 server tests green, 0 failures. Out of scope: SFU cascading (PipeTransport), cross-region (FR-105/106).
